scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace shared && concurrently "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace client"
scripts.dev:client: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run dev --workspace client
scripts.dev:server: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run dev --workspace server
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.build:client: npm run build --workspace shared && npm run build --workspace client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck --workspace shared && npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace client
